notes:
• New 📣 button: tell someone about AP Scout by email (your mail app, Gmail or Outlook web), Facebook Messenger, WhatsApp, Microsoft Teams, text message (Phone Link), a Facebook or LinkedIn post, or a QR code they scan with their phone. The message is editable and remembers your name.

• The title-bar update button now shows the result: “✓ Up to date · v2.2.2”, “⬆ Update to x.y.z”, or “⚠ Update check failed”. Click it any time to check again.
• AP Scout checks for updates a few seconds after it starts.

• New 🔄 Check for updates button in the title bar: click to check GitHub right now. It spins while checking, shows a green dot when a new version is ready, and its tooltip shows your version, what's new and when it last checked.

• Site survey: set the floor-plan scale in feet, continuous Walk mode, and a survey goal (Voice, Tablets & scanners, Business data, Basic/guest) with a Pass / fail map.
• New map layers: Pass / fail, Backup AP (2nd strongest), Ping to gateway.
• Best practices tab: checks channels, widths, SSID count, fast roaming (802.11r/k/v), security, PMF, look-alike networks, and (with UniFi/Meraki connected) power, minimum data rates, guest isolation, firmware and offline APs. Each item explains why it matters and how to fix it.
• Client report adds survey results with pass/fail maps for every floor, plus the best-practice review.
• Fix: a floor plan loaded on the 2nd+ floor no longer replaces the first floor's plan.
